envelope.description: Cancellation reaches the call in flight

body.title: Cancellation reaches the call in flight
body.summary: Add the optional signal to ProcessGroupOpts and aborted to ProcessGroupResult (kill the group on abort; an already-aborted signal spawns nothing). Forward StructuredCompletionOpts.signal and ReviewSessionOpts.signal through runSubprocess in CliProvider, throwing AbortError, never retried. Add the optional signal to CompletionOpts, and abort OllamaProvider.complete and completeStructured through a per-call fetch over the shared undici agent.
acceptanceChecks: Aborting a CLI call or reviewer session kills its process group and throws AbortError at once.
An aborted Ollama complete or completeStructured throws AbortError.
Without a signal, behaviour is unchanged.

tests.name: src/agent/providers/__tests__/abort-in-flight.test.ts: 'aborting a CLI completeStructured or reviewer session in flight kills the process group and throws AbortError at once; an aborted Ollama request throws AbortError; neither is retried'
